rationale: Monotonic non-increasing Volt-VAR curve with strictly increasing voltage breakpoints placed at the three feeder voltage levels. At the low-voltage step (base 0.94 pu) the curve injects reactive power (q_fraction=+0.19 -> Q=19 kvar, within sqrt(100^2-60^2)=80 kvar) raising the voltage to 0.953 pu, clearing the 0.95 pu sag. At nominal voltage (1.0 pu) the curve has a zero-injection deadband point, adding no control effort. At the high-voltage step (base 1.07 pu) the curve absorbs reactive power (q_fraction=-0.37 -> Q=-37 kvar, within the 80 kvar capability) lowering the voltage to 1.044 pu, clearing the 1.05 pu swell. All corrected voltages remain within [0.95, 1.05], the curve is strictly increasing in voltage and monotonic non-increasing in q_fraction, and reactive commands respect each inverter's capability, while keeping total |Q| control effort small.
